LOCAL_SERVER_DOWN.cause: The local helper server that modelBridge uses to communicate with Premiere Pro is not running or cannot be reached.
steps: Close and reopen Premiere Pro
If the issue persists, restart your computer
Check that no firewall or antivirus is blocking port 3000

NET_ERROR.cause: modelBridge could not reach fal.ai. This is usually a temporary network issue.
steps: Check your internet connection
Try again in a moment
If you are on a VPN or corporate network, check that fal.ai is not blocked

IMPORT_TIMEOUT.cause: The generated file was downloaded but Premiere Pro took too long to import it into the project.
steps: Try importing the file manually from the downloads folder
Check that Premiere Pro is not busy with another operation
Restart Premiere Pro if the issue persists

IMPORT_FAIL.cause: The generated file was downloaded but Premiere Pro could not import it. The file may be in a format Premiere does not support.
steps: Try importing the file manually from the downloads folder
Check that the file is not corrupted by opening it in another application
If the model outputs an unsupported format, try a different model

DOWNLOAD_FAIL.cause: The generated result could not be downloaded from fal.ai. The file may have expired or the connection was interrupted.
steps: Try generating again — you won't be charged if the result is still cached
Check your internet connection
If the issue persists, try a different model or shorter generation

EXTRACT_FAIL.cause: modelBridge could not extract the selected media from your Premiere Pro timeline for upload.
steps: Make sure a clip is selected in the timeline or project panel
Try selecting a different clip
If using a sequence, try selecting the individual clip instead

NO_SELECTION.cause: No clip or media item is currently selected in Premiere Pro.
steps: Click on a clip in the timeline or project panel
Make sure the clip is highlighted before clicking Generate

UPLOAD_FAIL.cause: The selected media could not be uploaded to fal.ai for processing. The file may be too large or the connection was interrupted.
steps: Try a smaller or shorter clip
Check your internet connection
Try again — upload failures are often temporary

ACCESS_GATED.cause: Some model creators restrict access to approved users. Your fal.ai account has not been granted access to this model yet.
steps: Visit the model page on fal.ai and request access
Check your fal.ai dashboard for pending access requests
Try a different model that does not require approval

ACCESS_SCOPE.cause: API keys can be scoped to specific permissions. The key saved in modelBridge is missing the scope required by this model.
steps: Generate a new API key with full permissions on fal.ai
Replace the key in the API & Support tab
If using a team key, ask your admin to grant the required scope

AUTH_INVALID.cause: Your fal.ai API key is missing, expired, or was entered incorrectly.
steps: Open the API & Support tab in modelBridge
Delete the current key and paste a fresh one from fal.ai
Click Save and try generating again

BALANCE_EMPTY.cause: Generations are billed per use. If your balance reaches zero or your account is locked, all new generations are blocked.
steps: Go to fal.ai billing and add funds
Return to modelBridge and try again
Check that your payment method is valid
If you've already added credits and still see this error, your account may need to be manually unlocked — contact fal.ai support

RATE_LIMIT.cause: fal.ai enforces per-account request limits to protect model availability. The limit resets automatically after a short cooldown.
steps: Wait 30–60 seconds and try again
Avoid clicking Generate multiple times in quick succession

CONTENT_POLICY.cause: fal.ai runs automated content moderation on prompts and images. Filters vary by model — some are stricter than others.
steps: Review your prompt for terms that may trigger content filters
Try rephrasing your prompt
If using an image, try a different source image

TIMEOUT.cause: The generation took too long and fal.ai stopped waiting. This can happen with complex prompts or busy servers.
steps: Try again — timeouts are often temporary
Try a shorter duration or simpler prompt
If the model is new, it may need time to warm up — try again in a minute

SERVER_ERROR.cause: The model's GPU worker crashed or returned an unexpected response. This is on fal.ai's side, not your input.
steps: Try again in a moment — server errors are usually temporary
If the error persists, the model may be experiencing issues
Try a different model as a workaround

PORT_CONFLICT.cause: Another application is already using port 3000, which modelBridge needs for its local helper server.
steps: Close other applications that may use port 3000 (e.g., other dev servers)
Restart Premiere Pro
If the issue persists, restart your computer to free the port

MODEL_NOT_FOUND.cause: Models on fal.ai can be removed, renamed, or replaced without notice. The endpoint this model was installed from no longer exists.
steps: Search for the model by name — it may have a new endpoint
Remove the model from your list and add the updated version
Check the fal.ai model page for migration guidance

SCHEMA_FAIL.cause: modelBridge could not load the model's configuration from fal.ai. The model's API schema may be temporarily unavailable.
steps: Try again in a moment
Remove and re-add the model
If the issue persists, the model may not be compatible with modelBridge

LICENSE_INVALID.cause: Your modelBridge subscription could not be verified. The license may have expired, or the license server is temporarily unreachable.
steps: Check your subscription status at modelbridge.app
Restart Premiere Pro after renewing
If the issue persists, check your internet connection — license verification requires a brief server check

LICENSE_DEVICE_LIMIT.cause: Your modelBridge license has reached the maximum number of activated devices. Each license allows a limited number of simultaneous activations.
steps: Go to the API & Support tab and click 'Use on a different device' to release this device
Or manage your devices at app.lemonsqueezy.com/my-orders
After releasing a device, try activating again

EXT_NOT_LOADED.cause: The modelBridge extension did not initialize completely. This usually happens after a Premiere Pro update or if the extension files were modified.
steps: Close and reopen Premiere Pro
If the issue persists, reinstall modelBridge from the installer
Check that unsigned extensions are enabled (PlayerDebugMode)

QUEUE_FAIL.cause: modelBridge could not submit the generation request to fal.ai. The request may have been rejected before entering the queue.
steps: Check your internet connection
Try again in a moment
If the issue persists, check fal.ai status for service disruptions

RESULT_NO_MEDIA_URL.cause: fal.ai completed the generation but the response did not contain a downloadable media file. The model may have returned metadata or an unsupported output format.
steps: Try generating again — this is sometimes a transient issue
Try a different model
Check fal.ai/dashboard for the raw result

VALIDATION_DURATION.cause: Video inpainting models require a mask video clip, not a still image. The mask was either a single frame or shorter than the model's minimum duration.
steps: Use the Draw Mask tool — it automatically creates a video mask at the correct duration
If using a URL, make sure it points to a video file, not an image
Trim your mask clip to meet the model's minimum duration, then try again

VALIDATION_TYPE.cause: One or more settings required by this model are missing or have an invalid value. Each model defines its own parameter requirements.
steps: Review the settings above the Generate button
Look for fields highlighted in red
If a required field is empty, enter a value and try again

FACE_NOT_DETECTED.cause: This model requires a clear, visible face in the input image. The AI could not detect a face in the image you provided.
steps: Use a photo where the face is well-lit and clearly visible
Ensure the face is not obscured by hair, accessories, or motion blur
Try a different photo with the subject facing the camera

IMAGE_LOAD_ERROR.cause: fal.ai could not process your image. The file may be corrupted, partially downloaded, or in an unsupported format.
steps: Re-export the image from Premiere Pro (File > Export Frame)
Try converting to JPG or PNG format
If using a URL, ensure the link is publicly accessible and points directly to an image file

AUDIO_DURATION_LONG.cause: The audio clip exceeds the maximum duration this model can process.
steps: Trim the audio to a shorter duration
Trim your audio clip to fit within the model's maximum duration, then try again
Try splitting long audio into shorter segments

AUDIO_DURATION_SHORT.cause: The audio clip is shorter than the minimum duration this model requires.
steps: Use a longer audio clip
For voice cloning models, use at least 3–5 seconds of clear speech
Use a longer audio clip that meets the model's minimum duration, then try again

DOWNSTREAM_ERROR.cause: A third-party service that this model depends on returned an error. This is not caused by your input.
steps: Try again in a few minutes
If the issue persists, the model's external dependency may be experiencing an outage
Try a different model as a workaround

GPU_MEMORY_EXCEEDED.cause: The model ran out of GPU memory during generation. This is a server-side resource issue on fal.ai, not caused by your input.
steps: Try again — GPU allocation varies between attempts
Try a lower resolution or shorter duration
If the issue persists, try a different model

INVALID_LORA_URL.cause: The model tried to load a LoRA (fine-tuning) weight file from a URL that could not be resolved.
steps: If you provided a LoRA URL, check that it is correct and publicly accessible
Try removing the LoRA URL and generating without it
If the model applies a built-in LoRA, this is a model-side issue — try a different model

SPEAKER_NOT_FOUND.cause: The model requires a valid speaker ID for voice synthesis, but the provided ID was not recognized.
steps: If the model has a speaker dropdown, select a different voice
Leave the speaker field empty to use the model's default voice
Check the model's documentation on fal.ai for available speaker IDs

EXTENDSCRIPT.cause: A Premiere Pro scripting operation failed. This can happen when Premiere Pro is busy, no sequence is open, or the timeline state is unexpected.
steps: Make sure a sequence is open and active in the timeline
Restart the modelBridge extension panel (Window > Extensions > modelBridge)
If the issue persists, restart Premiere Pro

SERVER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT.cause: The model took too long to load into GPU memory. This happens when a model hasn't been used recently and needs a "cold start."
steps: Try again immediately — the model is likely still loading from your first attempt
If it fails again, wait 1–2 minutes and retry
Try a more popular variant of the same model family

CONTENT_POLICY_NO_MEDIA.cause: The model ran but produced no usable output. Unlike a content violation, the model wasn't blocked — it simply couldn't create anything from your input and settings.
steps: Try a more specific, descriptive prompt
Use a source image with more detail and contrast
Use moderate settings: guidance scale 7–12, standard aspect ratio, mid-range duration
Try a different model
